title: Finish per-mark select-highlight support for ChartPopover's highlightBy option

complexity.rationale: ChartPopover already has an undocumented UNSAFE_highlightBy prop ('item' | 'dimension' | 'series' | string[]) and the underlying SELECTED_GROUP signal/groupId data plumbing (chartPopoverUtils.ts). Bar, Donut, and Venn already get group-aware opacity for free via the shared getMarkOpacity() (markUtils.ts:496-525), and Line has its own inline group-aware test (linePointUtils.ts:34-35). But Area's highlight expression (areaSpecBuilder.ts:170-199) and Scatter's opacity signal (scatterMarkUtils.ts:140-142) only ever check SELECTED_ITEM and would need genuinely different integration work (Area drives a filtered data source that also interleaves CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_ITEM and tooltip-hover precedence; Scatter has no groupId formula in its data pipeline at all). Plus real open design questions remain (Donut's deliberate 'dimension' exclusion, Combo cross-mark behavior, string[] scoping). Multiple sites needing different, non-precedented reasoning plus open questions => 5.

summary: ChartPopover's UNSAFE_highlightBy prop ('item' default, 'dimension', 'series', or string[] custom group keys) already exists and already drives popover content selection via a shared groupId transform, but only Line, Bar, Donut, and Venn actually respect the resulting group in their own mark highlight/opacity encodings — Area and Scatter still only respond to single-item selection, and Donut deliberately disables 'dimension' mode. This spec covers closing those gaps and promoting the prop out of its UNSAFE_/incomplete state.
requirements: Extend Area's highlight-driven data filter (getAreaHighlightedData in packages/vega-spec-builder/src/area/areaSpecBuilder.ts:170-199) to add a SELECTED_GROUP/_selectedGroupId branch when UNSAFE_highlightBy is 'dimension'/'series'/string[], slotted into the existing OR-chain alongside CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_ITEM and tooltip-hover checks without changing their precedence.

Extend Scatter's opacity encode (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/scatter/scatterMarkUtils.ts:140-142) and its selectedData source (scatterSpecBuilder.ts:127-133) to check group membership via a new _selectedGroupId formula, mirroring the pattern already used by getMarkOpacity for Bar/Donut/Venn.

Decide Donut's real behavior for 'dimension' mode, which packages/vega-spec-builder/src/chartPopover/chartPopoverUtils.ts:69 currently forces off entirely (`UNSAFE_highlightBy === 'dimension' && markOptions.markType !== 'donut'`) — confirm whether this exclusion is intentionally permanent (donut's dimension is already unique per segment, so 'dimension' grouping would be equivalent to 'item') and document it, or give it real per-mark meaning.

Remove the UNSAFE_ prefix and "This feature is incomplete" JSDoc from ChartPopoverOptions (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/types/dialogs/chartPopoverSpec.types.ts:33-34 and its S2 mirror) once all mark types have parity.
Document the prop in packages/docs/docs/api/interactivity/ChartPopover.md, which currently has no mention of highlightBy at all.
Verify how Combo charts (which host one ChartPopover across multiple constituent mark types) resolve highlightBy, since the option currently has no combo-specific handling.

edgeCases.case: highlightBy: 'series' on a chart with only one series
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Behaves like grouping all points of that single series; visually similar to 'item' mode only if the series has one point.

edgeCases.case: highlightBy: string[] naming a field absent from the data
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: getGroupIdTransform's formula (chartPopoverUtils.ts:91-97) evaluates datum.undefined for that key; should not throw, but currently has no defined fallback or validation.
Currently silently forced to item-level grouping (chartPopoverUtils.ts:69) instead of the requested mode; needs an explicit, documented decision rather than silent divergence.

edgeCases.case: Popover group-selection active while legend hover highlighting is also active
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The two systems use separate signal families (SELECTED_GROUP vs CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_SERIES/TABLE) and are not currently merged into one opacity expression outside of getMarkOpacity's own rule list; behavior should stay predictable, not flicker between the two.
Area and Scatter fixes must be mirrored into vega-spec-builder-s2, which has the identical gap today.

crossCutting.notes: touchesControlledHighlight: Area's getAreaHighlightedData (areaSpecBuilder.ts:170-199) already interleaves CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_ITEM with SELECTED_ITEM in one OR-chain expression; the new SELECTED_GROUP branch must be inserted into that same expression without reordering existing precedence. touchesTooltipOrPopover: this feature is entirely about ChartPopover's interactive-selection system (isInteractive, hasPopover, groupId data sources). requiresS1S2Parity: vega-spec-builder-s2's area/areaSpecBuilder.ts and scatter/scatterMarkUtils.ts have the identical SELECTED_ITEM-only gap and need the same fix. requiresNewSignalOrScale is false because SELECTED_GROUP and the _selectedGroupId field pattern already exist and are reused, not introduced.

implementationPlan.change: Add a SELECTED_GROUP/_selectedGroupId OR-branch to getAreaHighlightedData, positioned relative to the existing CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_ITEM and tooltip-hover checks.
Add a groupId formula transform to the scatter data pipeline (mirroring chartPopoverUtils.ts's getGroupIdTransform) so scatter has a _selectedGroupId field to test against.
Extend the opacity signal to also test SELECTED_GROUP membership, not just SELECTED_ITEM.
Resolve and document Donut's 'dimension' exclusion (currently forced off); adjust or clarify getGroupIdTransform usage accordingly.
Drop the UNSAFE_ prefix and incomplete-feature JSDoc once parity is reached across all mark types.
Add highlightBy to the props table; currently undocumented entirely.
Mirror the s1 Area fix for S2 parity.
Mirror the s1 Scatter fix for S2 parity.
Mirror the UNSAFE_ prefix removal once s2 also reaches parity.

openQuestions: Should Donut's forced exclusion of 'dimension' mode (chartPopoverUtils.ts:69) remain permanent and just be documented, given a donut segment's dimension value is already unique per row?
Should string[] custom-group-key mode be supported identically on every mark type, or scoped only to marks where grouped selection makes semantic sense (e.g. dodged/stacked bars)?
How should Combo charts (multiple mark types sharing one ChartPopover) resolve highlightBy — per-constituent-mark, or disabled/no-op for Combo entirely?
